title: My one "mall" astral experience described - Plus, is there a Donald Marshall REM/Clone connection here? Discussion.

classification.theory_summary: Speculates about a possible connection between shared 'mall world' experiences and Donald Marshall REM/clone-transfer claims; asks for discussion/feedback and whether others have seen specific mall features (horizontal conveyor belts).
classification.question_topic: Whether others share a specific 'futuristic mall over ocean/near airport with horizontal conveyor belts' experience; discussion of possible REM/clone connection.

meta.author_theory: Possible link between shared mall-world/astral experiences and REM-based 'clone transfer' claims (Donald Marshall); mentions government monitoring and mind control experimentation as possibilities (presented as speculation).

position.relative_to: suspended higher in the air above the ocean; likely sitting up upon a high ocean cliff side; about 100 feet up when looking down from the mall

qualities.raw_description: “futuristic mall that goes on for miles”; “suspended higher in the air above the ocean… up upon a high ocean cliff side… perhaps by about 100 feet”; “main hallway… overlooking the ocean… walls… enormous glass”; “glass walls… very high with amazing infrastructure”; “many open kiosks everywhere and it’s a bit like a maze”; “feels like it never ends.”
“many open kiosks everywhere”; “a lot of jewelry/clothing knick knack kiosks.”
“Like everyone else, I’ve seen an airport attached.”

Airport is described as “attached” to the mall (no specific passage described).

Uses/observes horizontal moving conveyor belts in the center of the halls to go faster down long hallways.
